instruction: I work late at night and the blue light from my screen hurts my eyes. Can you turn on Night Light to reduce blue light?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Night Light feature to reduce blue light. Config sets night-light-enabled to false, instruction asks to turn it on. The evaluator checks if the setting is true. Uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction (enable Night Light)

Practical feasibility: The evaluation approach is robust and will work correctly at runtime
